variant.note: Layer 2.1, long (three days per breath, four movements). The sky choir (voice and organ) sits above the sea on 13 distinct notes, D4 to A6; the sea has its own floor below on contrabass and cello, D1 to A3, warmest sea highest, so no two voices share a pitch. North sings on the left and south on the right, each hemisphere fuller and more open in its own summer and withdrawn in its winter. The in-breath is about 8 dB quieter and lower: breath, not hiss.
